summary: A work-week calendar where people drag events to a new time or day, click free time to add one, and open any event for its details. An agent button in the header asks your agent to find a slot, and the slots it suggests appear as outlined blocks with Book and Other. It shows scheduling help from an agent right inside the calendar people already use.
use: When an agent schedules meetings or finds free time for a team.
When people need to move and add events in a simple week view without a full calendar app.
When the agent can prepare something for a meeting, such as prep notes, from the event itself.
features: Shows `days` columns from `week` (5 by default) and `hours` rows from `startHour` (9am to 5pm by default), with a today mark and a now line when `now` is set.
Dragging an event moves it to another time or day in 15-minute steps; a click without moving opens its details card.
Hovering free time shows a "+ New event" slot, and clicking it adds an event, from `newEvent`, with a box to name it; Save keeps it and Discard removes it.
The details card shows the time and the people invited, plus Prep notes when `onPrepNotes` is set ("Writing" shows until a returned promise settles) and Join when `onJoin` is set.
With `onAsk`, the header gets the agent's button; while `finding` is true it shows a thinking mark and a scan line sweeps the week.

`suggestions` draw as outlined blocks; the first is the pick, with Book (`onBook`) and, while there are more, Other (`onSkip`). The header line reports the last move or addition, or your own `status`.

Under 520px wide, on a phone or in a narrow card, it shows one day at a time, picked from a row of days, so every event has room for its whole title and time. There each row is half an hour: an hour is two rows, and the time column reads 9:00, 9:30, 10:00. It opens on today, and on the day of the agent's pick when `suggestions` arrive; control the day with `day` and `onDayChange`.
a11y: The details card is a role="dialog" labelled "Event", and it is inert while closed.
Escape closes the details card; in a new event's title box, Enter saves and Escape discards.
Enter or Space on an event opens its details card with the focus in it, and closing the card gives the focus back to the event.
The title box is labelled "Event title", and the card's close button is labelled "Close".
On a narrow calendar the row of days is a group labelled "Day"; each day is a button with `aria-pressed` and its full date as its label.

faq.q: Does the calendar find free slots by itself?
faq.a: No. `onAsk` tells you the person pressed the agent's button. Set `finding` to true while your agent looks, then pass what it found as `suggestions` and set `finding` back to false.

faq.q: What should Book and Other do?
faq.a: `onBook` gets the picked suggestion: add it to `events` and clear `suggestions`. `onSkip` gets the one being skipped: drop it from `suggestions` and the next one becomes the pick.

faq.q: How do I save events after someone drags or adds one?
faq.a: Pass `events` and `onEventsChange`. Every move, new event, rename and removal comes back as the full updated list, with times as local Dates.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. Below 520px wide the week turns into a day view with a row of days to switch between, and dragging an event moves it within that day. The width of the calendar decides, not the screen, so a narrow card on a wide screen gets the day view too.

faq.q: Can I show a full week or longer hours?
faq.a: Yes. Set `days` to 7 for a full week, and `startHour` and `hours` for the time range, like `startHour={8}` and `hours={10}` for 8am to 6pm.
